  the first finding; let a fix-applying round close the gate.
- Rationale: preserves the protocol's auditable finding tree and fix-free clean-
  exit invariant.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43/#14 role mapping; Phase 10 generated workflows.

## D-059 — Publication manifest is a disjoint sidecar

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 33 Terra IMPORTANT
- Decision: Derive a same-parent sidecar outside the generated payload root.
  Payload grammar cannot name it. Verify exact payload first and replace the
  sidecar last. Same-tree retry may reconcile old-or-desired mixtures; changed
  desired output or intervening drift fails before retry mutation.
- Alternatives: put metadata inside payload equality; reserve an in-root path;
  omit retry controls.
- Rationale: exact RenderedTree equality and control metadata cannot occupy the
  same namespace, and partial retry needs a closed executable oracle.
- Surfaces: Pasture #38/#46 and target publishers.

## D-060 — Role normalization uses state, not a marker

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 33 Terra IMPORTANT
- Decision: Application/#43 extracts, conditionally transfers all eligible
  generic roles in one batch, then deterministically requeries exact eligible
  state before enabling commands. No marker/task/snapshot/event/table is added;
  an empty database succeeds by inspection.
- Alternatives: invent a marker host or new table; attach a global event to an
  arbitrary task.
- Rationale: current assignments already are the authoritative completion state.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43/#14; Provenance #5 remains generic.

## D-061 — Slice close consumes TaskCandidateID

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 33 Terra MINOR
- Decision: The frozen slice-close API/CLI uses canonical TaskCandidateID
  directly. ReviewSubjectRef remains the internal sum-level review abstraction,
  not a redundant close operand.
- Alternatives: retain removed ReviewSubjectID spelling; accept a generic ref and
  revalidate its variant at close.
- Rationale: slice close always targets one implementation candidate.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43 CLI/effect schemas and generated bindings.

## D-062 — TUI alone owns preference persistence

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 33 Terra MINOR
- Decision: The installer TUI loads/saves preferences and derives an immutable
  EffectiveSelection. `apply-selection` and `apply-cell` read no preference and
  write only factual operational inventory.
- Alternatives: make apply-selection also load/save preferences.
- Rationale: preserves one clear caller boundary and matches Home Manager's
  effective-document contract.
- Surfaces: Pasture #39 installer/TUI/CLI.

## D-063 — Read-only publication replay and eligibility preflight

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 34 Terra BLOCKER/IMPORTANT findings
- Decision: Provenance #5 exposes a side-effect-free exact committed-operation
  lookup with Absent/Committed/Conflict outcomes. `publish-repository` uses that
  first, then a #43 read-only current-set/review/UAT/authority/canonical-evidence
  preflight before Git, followed by the existing in-batch conditional recheck.
  Exactly one publication event may exist per integration-set/repository pair.
- Alternatives: always rerun already-at-target verification before Apply and
  provide no replay-only result; perform eligibility validation only after Git;
  introduce a Git/SQLite transaction or global publication lock.
- Rationale: lost-response replay must not require Git, stale-at-entry calls must
  not mutate a remote, and duplicate MutationRefs must not duplicate evidence.
  A race after the read-only preflight remains an explicitly nontransactional
  partial success: report the advanced OID and require a replacement set with
  fresh review/UAT rather than rollback.
- UAT question: confirm that post-preflight rework races should require explicit
  replacement-set reconciliation rather than stronger cross-system locking.
- Surfaces: Provenance #5; Pasture #14/#43/#40/#46; publication and landing.

## D-064 — Separate UAT interactions, feedback, and held questions

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 34 Terra correctness BLOCKER
- Decision: Normal question/options/definition/command/verbatim-answer records
  carry no disposition. Only actionable feedback carries user-confirmed FIX-NOW
  or DEFER. Plan-UAT questions held for Implementation UAT have their own type
  with complete stimulus and hold reason but no fabricated answer/disposition.
  `changes_requested` requires structured FIX-NOW feedback.
- Alternatives: force every answer into FIX-NOW/DEFER; omit positive answers;
  encode held questions as answered feedback.
- Rationale: acceptance interactions are evidence without being defects, while
  only actual deferred feedback may feed the follow-up epic.
- UAT question: confirm the held-question record presented at Implementation UAT
  is the desired replacement for an overnight synchronous Plan-UAT interview.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43 UAT API/CLI/events; ratify/land/follow-up gates.

## D-065 — Findings resolve only through evidence-bound subject replacement

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 34 Terra BLOCKER findings
- Decision: There is no public in-place `finding-resolve` operation. Fixes use
  typed slice/integration rework with a distinct C2 and a complete mapping from
  every submitted finding to worker Activity, Git evidence, test evidence, and
  C2. The same batch terminalizes all findings, severity groups, BLOCKER
  dual-parent edges, axes, assignments, the old round, and dependencies before
  swapping the current subject. C2 requires a new eager review round.
- Alternatives: resolve findings while C1 stays current; forbid rework until a
  finding-bearing round finalizes; allow an unchanged subject to be re-reviewed.
- Rationale: review must prove the bytes that contain the fix and no obsolete
  eager-graph edge may strand the slice or integration task.
- UAT question: confirm that historical findings should close as addressed by a
  specific replacement rather than remain open after C2 becomes current.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43 review/slice/integration algebra and Phase 10 workflows.

## D-066 — Plan finalize is the sole terminal owner

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 34 Terra elegance IMPORTANT
- Decision: All three Plan-review axes submit one binary vote and end their own
  assignments. Submit never closes the round or cancels siblings. `review
  finalize` alone derives ACCEPT when all accept or REVISE otherwise and owns the
  terminal event/dependency transition. Proposal supersede alone invalidates an
  unfinished round.
- Alternatives: first REVISE submit closes the round and cancels siblings;
  permit both submit and finalize to close REVISE.
- Rationale: one terminal owner removes conflicting state transitions and keeps
  the full three-axis review record required for consensus analysis.
- UAT question: confirm complete three-axis feedback is preferred even when an
  earlier Plan-review axis already voted REVISE.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43 Plan review API/CLI/events and proposal supersession.

## D-067 — #43 owns publication identity and every success commits a result

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 35 Terra correctness/test/elegance
- Decision: #43 alone canonicalizes a versioned PublicationIntent and its
  CanonicalCommandDigest. #14 maps MutationRef, historical actor, and digest
  byte-preserving into #5 lookup/Apply; #40 never maps identity or calls #5.
  Process-local Git proof gates append but is not part of canonical intent bytes.
  Existing evidence and concurrent append convergence commit a result-only
  OperationID binding to the one canonical EventID, so every successful status
  replays identically without creating duplicate evidence.
- Alternatives: let #40 construct/marshal Provenance identity; return read-only
  already-recorded success without an operation row; include ephemeral Git proof
  in the replay command digest.
- Rationale: lookup and Apply need one provably identical command identity, and
  logical continuation requires lost responses to replay after authority/repo
  state changes.
- UAT question: confirm that a result-only operation row referencing existing
  evidence is acceptable audit state and not the pending/transaction machinery
  previously rejected.
- Surfaces: Provenance #5; Pasture #14/#43/#40; publication/landing.

## D-068 — Implementation UAT requires total typed carry-forward coverage

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 35 Terra BLOCKER/IMPORTANT findings
- Decision: Plan decisions, held questions, deferred feedback, ledger revisions,
  and ledger entries use stable typed IDs. The ledger is immutable-revisioned;
  implementation judgments extend rather than mutate the Plan-bound snapshot.
  Implementation UAT binds the exact Plan decision and current successor ledger,
  then requires a bijection over every held question, Plan-DEFER feedback, and
  RequiresUAT ledger entry. A coverage digest is part of accepted evidence and
  the land predicate. FIX-NOW or ledger REPLACE forces changes-requested; user-
  confirmed DEFER alone feeds follow-up.
- Alternatives: present the ledger text informally; reference only its mutable
  TaskID; allow user acceptance without mechanically complete coverage.
- Rationale: the user's overnight deferral is safe only if no held question or
  agent judgment can disappear before the morning Implementation-UAT gate.
- UAT question: review and disposition every stable carry-forward item; acceptance
  is intentionally unavailable until coverage is complete.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43 UAT/ledger API, ratify, land, follow-up generation.

## D-069 — Distinguish finding fixes from independent subject drift

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 35 Terra elegance IMPORTANT
- Decision: `address_findings` rework waits for all three implementation-review
  inventories and binds every finding to a distinct replacement plus Activity/
  Git/test evidence. `independent_content_replacement` may invalidate a partial
  round only while every submitted inventory is finding-free; it explicitly
  records incomplete invalidation and never claims findings were addressed.
- Alternatives: rework after the first finding and cancel unseen inventories;
  forbid all candidate replacement until three submissions; use one ambiguous
  rework reason.
- Rationale: fixes need the complete three-axis finding set, while genuine
  unrelated drift should not force reviewers to finish inspecting obsolete bytes.
- UAT question: confirm partial independent replacement is acceptable only before
  any reviewer reports a finding.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43 slice/integration review and Phase-10 workflows.

## D-070 — Tracker #44 is normative and must match the ratified state machine

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 35 Terra correctness BLOCKER
- Decision: Tracker #44 is synchronized in every proposal revision before review
  because it is the Phase-8 implementation entrypoint. It now uses all-three Plan
  submissions/finalize, `REVISE_REPLACED`, two typed rework reasons, total UAT
  carry-forward, and #43-owned publication identity/result binding.
- Alternatives: treat #44 as a nonnormative summary and let implementation use
  only the proposal/leaf issue bodies.
- Rationale: contradictory normative trackers recreate the exact ambiguity the
  review loop is intended to eliminate.
- Surfaces: Pasture #44 and all dependent implementation slices.

## D-071 — Two-stage canonicalization and exact replay authority

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 36 Terra correctness/test findings
- Decision: After resolving typed inputs, the runtime first calls #43's pure
  command canonicalizer. Only then does it mint MutationRef and durably record a
  complete continuation. Stateful preparation recomputes and validates the
  digest before lookup. #14 maps the exact initiating AssignmentRef or bootstrap
  identity to #5 OperationAuthorityID; replay compares OperationID, ActorID,
  exact authority, and command digest.
- Alternatives: let preparation produce a digest after continuation recording;
  accept a placeholder/caller digest; compare only AgentID.
- Rationale: removes the construction cycle and prevents same-Agent assignments,
  slots, tasks, or bootstrap authority from aliasing one mutation.
- UAT question: confirm the extra pure canonicalization call is acceptable for
  every task mutation in exchange for reconstructable fresh-agent identity.
- Surfaces: Provenance #5; Pasture #14/#43/#40 and generated task bindings.

## D-072 — Narrow conditional existing-ID result binding

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 36 Terra BLOCKERs
- Decision: Provenance #5 ConditionalMutationBatch gains one closed zero-domain/
  event form. Exact typed preconditions produce unforgeable existing-ID handles;
  result slots may project only those handles. At least one state/authority
  precondition is required; literals, scalars, arbitrary maps, allocation, domain
  mutation, and event drafts are forbidden. Publication binds the canonical
  EventID and derives outcome from its protected payload.
- Alternatives: return read-only convergence without durable replay; add a
  generic arbitrary result map; duplicate publication evidence per operation.
- Rationale: every successful logical mutation needs replayable results without
  turning a no-domain convergence into a pending system or duplicate audit event.
- UAT question: confirm operation/result-only persistence is acceptable because
  it is final idempotency evidence, not a pending step/recovery ledger.
- Surfaces: Provenance #5; Pasture #14/#43/#40; publication replay.

## D-073 — Independent replacement is total across clean nonterminal states

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 36 Terra rework BLOCKERs
- Decision: `independent_content_replacement` is legal before close/land whenever
  there is no live finding-bearing round: no round, partial/all-submitted clean,
  finalized clean, post-UAT, or post-publication. It terminalizes only open
  branches, preserves already-terminal clean axes/assignments and immutable
  historical evidence, invalidates current eligibility, installs C2, and forces
  fresh review/UAT/publication. Finding-addressing still waits for all three.
- Alternatives: add a separate post-finalize mode; forbid all post-finalize
  change; rewrite already-terminal dispositions.
- Rationale: one independent-drift mode is total without double-terminalization
  or deadlocking legitimate merge/rebase/commit changes.
- UAT question: confirm independent replacement should remain legal after
  accepted UAT/publication but before terminal land, with all gates rerun.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43 slice/integration review, UAT, publication, land.

## D-074 — Protected ledger producer and stale-UAT invalidation

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 36 Terra ledger BLOCKER/IMPORTANT
- Decision: DECISION_LEDGER is a protected #43 protocol-document kind. Protocol
  create makes its initial immutable revision/current relation/architect owner;
  append-only protocol revise preserves stable prior entries and is transferred
  to supervisor at handoff. UAT requirement derives from SourceAgentJudgment and
  cannot be suppressed. Appending a required entry invalidates accepted
  Implementation UAT; land CASes the current ledger revision and coverage digest;
  post-land append rejects.
- Alternatives: dedicated ledger command alongside protocol revise; mutable body
  comments only; caller-provided RequiresUAT boolean; land ignores later entries.
- Rationale: the carry-forward consumer needs one authoritative producer and no
  judgment may appear after acceptance without reopening the user gate.
- UAT question: confirm all post-Plan agent judgments should mechanically reopen
  Implementation UAT until explicitly covered.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43 protocol/ledger/UAT/land and tracker #44.

## D-075 — User-confirmed ledger source requires protected human evidence

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 37 Terra correctness/test/elegance
  BLOCKERs
- Decision: The ordinary ledger-owner append always derives
  SourceAgentJudgment from its exact mutation authority. SourceUserConfirmed is
  a separate closed producer that must reference exact protected registered-
  human decision/interaction evidence and atomically match the task, human,
  complete stimulus, verbatim answer, entry, and digests. Unbacked, stale,
  mismatched, cross-ledger, or legacy input conservatively requires UAT.
- Alternatives: trust an owner-supplied source enum; remove SourceUserConfirmed
  and re-present every prior user decision; accept a caller RequiresUAT flag.
- Rationale: source classification is authorization-sensitive because it
  controls whether a judgment can be omitted from Implementation UAT.
- UAT question: confirm that previously user-confirmed entries may skip repeat
  disposition only when exact protected human evidence is available.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43 decision ledger/UAT; tracker #44.

## D-076 — Decision ledger reuses document revisions and every append invalidates UAT

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 37 Terra correctness/elegance
  BLOCKER/IMPORTANT findings
- Decision: DECISION_LEDGER uses the existing DocumentRevisionID plus reserved
  current-revision topology, with an append-only ledger codec. Every successor
  ledger revision after accepted Implementation UAT invalidates the current UAT,
  regardless of source; a fresh UAT must bind the new exact revision.
- Alternatives: maintain DecisionLedgerRevisionID/current-ledger-revision as a
  parallel model; invalidate only entries that currently require coverage;
  atomically synthesize replacement UAT for user-confirmed appends.
- Rationale: one document revision model removes redundant topology, and total
  invalidation prevents an accepted-but-unlandable stranded state.
- UAT question: confirm that even a newly evidenced user-confirmed ledger append
  should force a fresh exact-revision Implementation-UAT decision.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43 protected documents, UAT, land; tracker #44.

## D-077 — Mutation continuation freezes the complete resolved request and scope

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 37 Terra correctness BLOCKER
- Decision: Before the first stateful attempt, the durable continuation stores
  MutationRef, exact initiating authority, semantic operation/request schema,
  immutable canonical resolved request bytes and digest, typed result
  declarations, and the frozen lexical-scope snapshot. Fresh agents reconstruct
  from that record alone.
- Alternatives: retain only a non-invertible digest; reconstruct from the latest
  AssignmentContext; store an opaque process-local closure.
- Rationale: logical continuity cannot promise byte-identical crash recovery if
  the request and scope needed for replay were never persisted.
- UAT question: confirm storing immutable canonical request bytes in the
  continuation is acceptable despite the larger durable context record.
- Surfaces: Pasture #38/#40/#43, #14 adapter, generated runtime bindings.

## D-078 — Public handle sum receives exhaustive fixtures and drift rules name the live subject

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 37 Terra test/elegance findings
- Decision: Keep all four ConditionalExistingIDResult handle branches—Task,
  Assignment, Activity, Event—and table-drive positive projection, cross-domain,
  zero/multiple projection, restart/replay, races, and fault rollback through #5
  and #14. Rework rejection refers only to findings on the current subject/current
  live round; historical findings do not block later independent drift.
- Alternatives: narrow the MVP result form to Event only; leave unused branches
  untested; interpret any historical finding as a permanent drift prohibition.
- Rationale: the generic atomic API is intentionally useful beyond publication,
  but every public branch must be validated and historical audit evidence cannot
  make a clean successor artifact immutable forever.
- UAT question: confirm retaining the four-domain result projection API is worth
  the broader validation surface.
- Surfaces: Provenance #5; Pasture #14/#43 rework; tracker #44.

## D-072 — Narrow conditional existing-ID result binding

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 36 Terra BLOCKERs
- Decision: Provenance #5 ConditionalMutationBatch gains one closed zero-domain/
  event form. Exact typed preconditions produce unforgeable existing-ID handles;
  result slots may project only those handles. At least one state/authority
  precondition is required; literals, scalars, arbitrary maps, allocation, domain
  mutation, and event drafts are forbidden. Publication binds the canonical
  EventID and derives outcome from its protected payload.
- Alternatives: return read-only convergence without durable replay; add a
  generic arbitrary result map; duplicate publication evidence per operation.
- Rationale: every successful logical mutation needs replayable results without
  turning a no-domain convergence into a pending system or duplicate audit event.
- UAT question: confirm operation/result-only persistence is acceptable because
  it is final idempotency evidence, not a pending step/recovery ledger.
- Surfaces: Provenance #5; Pasture #14/#43/#40; publication replay.

## D-073 — Independent replacement is total across clean nonterminal states

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 36 Terra rework BLOCKERs
- Decision: `independent_content_replacement` is legal before close/land whenever
  there is no live finding-bearing round: no round, partial/all-submitted clean,
  finalized clean, post-UAT, or post-publication. It terminalizes only open
  branches, preserves already-terminal clean axes/assignments and immutable
  historical evidence, invalidates current eligibility, installs C2, and forces
  fresh review/UAT/publication. Finding-addressing still waits for all three.
- Alternatives: add a separate post-finalize mode; forbid all post-finalize
  change; rewrite already-terminal dispositions.
- Rationale: one independent-drift mode is total without double-terminalization
  or deadlocking legitimate merge/rebase/commit changes.
- UAT question: confirm independent replacement should remain legal after
  accepted UAT/publication but before terminal land, with all gates rerun.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43 slice/integration review, UAT, publication, land.

## D-074 — Protected ledger producer and stale-UAT invalidation

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 36 Terra ledger BLOCKER/IMPORTANT
- Decision: DECISION_LEDGER is a protected #43 protocol-document kind. Protocol
  create makes its initial immutable revision/current relation/architect owner;
  append-only protocol revise preserves stable prior entries and is transferred
  to supervisor at handoff. UAT requirement derives from SourceAgentJudgment and
  cannot be suppressed. Appending a required entry invalidates accepted
  Implementation UAT; land CASes the current ledger revision and coverage digest;
  post-land append rejects.
- Alternatives: dedicated ledger command alongside protocol revise; mutable body
  comments only; caller-provided RequiresUAT boolean; land ignores later entries.
- Rationale: the carry-forward consumer needs one authoritative producer and no
  judgment may appear after acceptance without reopening the user gate.
- UAT question: confirm all post-Plan agent judgments should mechanically reopen
  Implementation UAT until explicitly covered.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43 protocol/ledger/UAT/land and tracker #44.

## D-075 — User-confirmed ledger source requires protected human evidence

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 37 Terra correctness/test/elegance
  BLOCKERs
- Decision: The ordinary ledger-owner append always derives
  SourceAgentJudgment from its exact mutation authority. SourceUserConfirmed is
  a separate closed producer that must reference exact protected registered-
  human decision/interaction evidence and atomically match the task, human,
  complete stimulus, verbatim answer, entry, and digests. Unbacked, stale,
  mismatched, cross-ledger, or legacy input conservatively requires UAT.
- Alternatives: trust an owner-supplied source enum; remove SourceUserConfirmed
  and re-present every prior user decision; accept a caller RequiresUAT flag.
- Rationale: source classification is authorization-sensitive because it
  controls whether a judgment can be omitted from Implementation UAT.
- UAT question: confirm that previously user-confirmed entries may skip repeat
  disposition only when exact protected human evidence is available.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43 decision ledger/UAT; tracker #44.

## D-076 — Decision ledger reuses document revisions and every append invalidates UAT

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 37 Terra correctness/elegance
  BLOCKER/IMPORTANT findings
- Decision: DECISION_LEDGER uses the existing DocumentRevisionID plus reserved
  current-revision topology, with an append-only ledger codec. Every successor
  ledger revision after accepted Implementation UAT invalidates the current UAT,
  regardless of source; a fresh UAT must bind the new exact revision.
- Alternatives: maintain DecisionLedgerRevisionID/current-ledger-revision as a
  parallel model; invalidate only entries that currently require coverage;
  atomically synthesize replacement UAT for user-confirmed appends.
- Rationale: one document revision model removes redundant topology, and total
  invalidation prevents an accepted-but-unlandable stranded state.
- UAT question: confirm that even a newly evidenced user-confirmed ledger append
  should force a fresh exact-revision Implementation-UAT decision.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43 protected documents, UAT, land; tracker #44.

## D-077 — Mutation continuation freezes the complete resolved request and scope

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 37 Terra correctness BLOCKER
- Decision: Before the first stateful attempt, the durable continuation stores
  MutationRef, exact initiating authority, semantic operation/request schema,
  immutable canonical resolved request bytes and digest, typed result
  declarations, and the frozen lexical-scope snapshot. Fresh agents reconstruct
  from that record alone.
- Alternatives: retain only a non-invertible digest; reconstruct from the latest
  AssignmentContext; store an opaque process-local closure.
- Rationale: logical continuity cannot promise byte-identical crash recovery if
  the request and scope needed for replay were never persisted.
- UAT question: confirm storing immutable canonical request bytes in the
  continuation is acceptable despite the larger durable context record.
- Surfaces: Pasture #38/#40/#43, #14 adapter, generated runtime bindings.

## D-078 — Public handle sum receives exhaustive fixtures and drift rules name the live subject

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 37 Terra test/elegance findings
- Decision: Keep all four ConditionalExistingIDResult handle branches—Task,
  Assignment, Activity, Event—and table-drive positive projection, cross-domain,
  zero/multiple projection, restart/replay, races, and fault rollback through #5
  and #14. Rework rejection refers only to findings on the current subject/current
  live round; historical findings do not block later independent drift.
- Alternatives: narrow the MVP result form to Event only; leave unused branches
  untested; interpret any historical finding as a permanent drift prohibition.
- Rationale: the generic atomic API is intentionally useful beyond publication,
  but every public branch must be validated and historical audit evidence cannot
  make a clean successor artifact immutable forever.
- UAT question: confirm retaining the four-domain result projection API is worth
  the broader validation surface.
- Surfaces: Provenance #5; Pasture #14/#43 rework; tracker #44.

{"description":"# Proposal 27 planning and implementation decision ledger

Status: provisional until Implementation UAT unless marked USER-CONFIRMED.

## D-001 — Failed uninstall state

- Source: USER-CONFIRMED
- Decision: Keep preferences separate from a factual XDG installation-state
  inventory recording installed/absent/unknown, what remains, and actionable
  failures. Ordinary reruns retry failed removals.
- Alternatives: preference deltas only; manual `apply-cell` only; rollback.
- Rationale: the user explicitly requires knowing what was installed and whether
  uninstall completed, without a cross-cell transaction model.
- Surfaces: URD R3.1/R5; Pasture #39; Aura #8; Proposal 27 §§7/12/13.

## D-002 — State transition durability

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT
- Decision: Atomically mark one cell `unknown` before its native/file action,
  then probe and persist installed/absent or the strongest failure observation.
- Alternatives: write only after action; append-only operation journal.
- Rationale: a crash after mutation but before observation remains discoverable
  and retryable without a pending queue or rollback engine.
- UAT question: confirm the brief pre-action `unknown` marker is acceptable as
  factual state rather than unwanted transaction machinery.
- Surfaces: Pasture #39 state schema/status/tests.

## D-003 — Existing and modified DirectFiles

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT
- Decision: Use embedded exact manifests. Matching unrecorded files are external
  and never removed; differing/wrong-type/symlink/modified managed files are
  actionable conflicts, not overwritten. Remove only matching managed leaves
  and empty directories Pasture created.
- Alternatives: overwrite after confirmation; adopt matching external files;
  symlink installer output.
- Rationale: preserves user data and makes uninstall ownership falsifiable.
- Surfaces: target #24/#27/#45 ArtifactBundles; #39; Aura #8.

## D-004 — Runtime artifact carrier

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT
- Decision: Target packages publish opaque `go:embed`-backed ArtifactBundles
  with path/type/mode/digest manifests; the CLI never resolves from cwd.
- Alternatives: installed versioned share tree.
- Rationale: one self-contained released CLI and deterministic tests from an
  empty directory.
- Surfaces: Pasture #24/#27/#45/#39.

## D-005 — Mixed installer and Home Manager control

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT
- Decision: Simultaneous mixed control of one cell is unsupported and reported
  with the recorded controller and a single-controller repair; no concurrency
  or lease protocol is introduced.
- Alternatives: precedence rules; multi-controller reference counting.
- Rationale: honors the user's instruction not to design concurrent installation
  coordination while avoiding silent cross-controller removal.
- Surfaces: Pasture #39; Aura #8.

## D-006 — Slice-close identity claim

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT
- Decision: Resolve actors from recorded AssignmentID and describe enforcement
  as protocol-policy validation, not authentication against a hostile local DB
  user. No actor/supervisor override exists on protected review/close commands.
- Alternatives: authenticated agent sessions/credentials.
- Rationale: authenticated identity is a materially larger security product not
  requested in the URE.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43 and generated task workflows.

## D-007 — Clean review evidence

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT
- Decision: One immutable ReviewSubjectID plus ReviewRoundID, three distinct
  assigned reviewers/axes, 0/0/0, `fixes_applied=false`, matching current
  content, and no later REVISE/mutation are required. Protected review events
  cannot be created by generic event record.
- Alternatives: loose A/B/C EventID collection.
- Rationale: directly encodes the protocol's fix-free clean-round invariant.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43; Provenance-backed event definitions.

## D-008 — Shared effect ownership

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT
- Decision: #38 owns opaque EffectID/EffectSet codec/equality/compatibility; #43
  and #46 independently contribute concrete task and process/Git/filesystem
  effects; #40 consumes both.
- Alternatives: #41 depends on #46.
- Rationale: keeps capability descriptors independent of one concrete effect
  family and preserves the issue DAG.
- Surfaces: Pasture #38/#41/#43/#46/#40.

## D-009 — Home Manager legacy compatibility

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT
- Decision: One release preserves non-default role filters through an exact
  legacy filtered DirectFile mode mutually exclusive with the aggregate plugin.
  Extra commands/agents become additive `extraFiles` with identity-collision
  errors. Simple legacy booleans alias new parent/child options.
- Alternatives: immediate breaking removal; role-granular native plugins;
  permanent dual delivery.
- Rationale: preserves existing behavior without expanding the canonical native
  package matrix indefinitely.
- Surfaces: Aura #8; Pasture #45/#39 integration.

## D-010 — Event pagination snapshots

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT
- Decision: First page freezes SnapshotMaxEventID; cursors are exclusive;
  filters are OR within dimensions and AND across them. Context edges carry
  their attachment EventID so later attachments do not alter a traversal.
- Alternatives: live pagination; EventID-only order.
- Rationale: preserves required `(RecordedAt, EventID)` order without duplicate/
  missing rows under concurrent or backdated inserts.
- Surfaces: Provenance #4/#5; Pasture #43.

## D-011 — Timeline interval ordering

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT
- Decision: point events sort by `(RecordedAt, EventID)`; Activity intervals by
  `(StartedAt, StartEventID)`, retain start/end source IDs, and are open when no
  end exists under the snapshot watermark.
- Alternatives: end-time order; emit un-folded start/end rows.
- Rationale: stable lifecycle chronology and deterministic overlapping intervals.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43.

## D-012 — Legacy import and non-task rows

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT
- Decision: #14 serially imports validated rows sorted by time/legacy ID and owns
  `pasture legacy-audit event list`; #43 owns typed task fan-out import. Source
  rows remain byte-equivalent and actor text is retained on fallback.
- Alternatives: parallel import; runtime merge into task timelines.
- Rationale: deterministic EventIDs and a clean task/non-task API boundary.
- Surfaces: Pasture #14/#43; Provenance #5.

## D-013 — Task CLI compatibility

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT
- Decision: `pasture task contract --json` exposes CLI semver, TaskContractID,
  schema ranges, and definition digest; generated artifacts probe before their
  first mutation.
- Alternatives: assume exact co-delivery.
- Rationale: plugin-managed generated packages can update independently of the
  locally installed CLI.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43/#40/targets.

## D-014 — Moving release ref race

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT
- Decision: Aura promotion takes `--expected-old <sha|absent>` and performs a
  guarded remote update; racing publishers are preserved.
- Alternatives: unguarded force update; immutable release refs only.
- Rationale: retain native moving-ref updates without overwriting reviewed work.
- Surfaces: Aura #9; Pasture #39 Codex fixtures.

## D-015 — UAT timing and supervisor continuity

- Source: USER-CONFIRMED
- Scope: ONLY the current epoch rooted at REQUEST `aura-plugins-ydhf9`; this is
  not a reusable Pasture protocol rule or product capability.
- Decision: After clean proposal consensus, skip the separate Plan UAT, ratify,
  and continue directly to implementation with the same primary agent acting as
  supervisor. Hold all questions and judgments for Implementation UAT.
- Non-effect: Pasture's general Plan-UAT algebra still requires an ordinary
  accepted decision before ratification; it does not gain a reusable
  `deferred_to_implementation_uat` verdict from this exception.
- Surfaces: Proposal 27 ratification/handoff; implementation plan; Impl UAT.

## D-016 — Proposal 27 post-filing amendments

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT
- Decision: Keep the complete filed Proposal 27 body and append the four small
  post-filing clarifications as a Beads comment rather than create Proposal 28.
- Alternatives: create another proposal task solely to absorb small amendments;
  condense the body so Beads can audit an in-place replacement.
- Rationale: Beads rejected the refresh before mutation because its audit
  `old_value` column could not snapshot the 91 KB task. Append-only amendment
  preserves full detail and avoids proposal-number churn.
- Surfaces: Proposal 27 `aura-plugins-r0pf0` body plus canonical amendment
  comment; local `/tmp/followup-proposal-27.md` remains the assembled review copy.

## D-017 — Pre-inventory legacy exception

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT
- Decision: Generic exact pre-existing components are adopted only when selected
  true; the sole exception is the exact published user-scoped Claude v0.0.4
  monolith, which is an approved migration candidate reconciled to desired split
  or absent state. Every near-match remains external with zero mutation.
- Alternatives: never remove a pre-inventory monolith; treat every matching
  current plugin as managed even when selected false.
- Rationale: preserves the already-approved destructive legacy transition
  without generalizing unsafe ownership inference.
- Surfaces: Pasture #39/#45; Proposal 27 installer bootstrap/state table.

## D-018 — Installation digest and state-file codec

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT
- Decision: Exact-byte SHA-256 typed digests, lexicographic relative paths,
  explicit octal modes, public nine-cell state order, unknown/duplicate rejection,
  and mode-0600 same-directory flushed atomic replacement with state-file
  symlink rejection.
- Alternatives: implementation-defined hash/YAML order; native file metadata;
  append-only state log.
- Rationale: safe modified-file detection and deterministic/corruption-resistant
  inventory without expanding into an authorization or transaction system.
- Surfaces: Pasture #24/#27/#45 ArtifactBundles and #39 state persistence.

## D-019 — Overnight implementation review budget

- Source: USER-DIRECTED + AGENT-JUDGMENT
- Decision: Use an unlimited review/fix/re-review budget until a fix-free 0/0/0
  round, without pausing at the Phase-8 budget gate. Confirm this provisional
  choice with the full ledger at Implementation UAT.
- Alternatives: three rounds; one round; zero rounds; interrupt the overnight
  continuation to ask.
- Rationale: the user explicitly directed autonomous progression until every
  reviewer reaches 0/0/0 and deferred all questions to Implementation UAT.
- Surfaces: Proposal 28; implementation plan; per-slice review.

## D-020 — Neutral artifact bundle ownership

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Terra elegance BLOCKER
- Decision: New Pasture #48 owns opaque `artifact.Bundle`, BundleID, manifest,
  entry/digest codecs, constructors, validation, and `go:embed`/`fs.FS`
  boundary. Targets #24/#27/#45 publish concrete bundles; #39 only activates
  them.
- Alternatives: let downstream #39 define the upstream publisher type; use raw
  fs.FS plus duplicated serialized manifests.
- Rationale: removes a dependency inversion without coupling neutral artifact
  structure to installation or runtime policy.
- Surfaces: Pasture #48/#24/#27/#45/#39; tracker #44.

## D-021 — Authoritative assignment aggregate

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Terra correctness BLOCKER
- Decision: Provenance #5 owns typed TaskAssignment lifecycle with one active
  `(TaskID, AssignmentSlotID)`, atomic start/end/reassign/batch, parent or
  registered-bootstrap origin, predecessor history, and cumulative attribution.
  Pasture #43 defines supervisor/reviewer slots and closure/review policy.
- Alternatives: treat AssignmentID as caller-supplied event evidence; define a
  review-only assignment table in Pasture.
- Rationale: one authoritative lifecycle supports delegation, ownership,
  reviews, actor resolution, and deterministic audit without duplicating task
  state.
- Surfaces: Provenance #5; Pasture #14/#43/#40.

## D-022 — Review sealing and task-kind closure

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Terra test/correctness findings
- Decision: One terminal submission per review assignment; REVISE permanently
  seals the round and re-review creates a new round/assignments. Ordinary leaf,
  review, slice, and protocol-container closure each have explicit actor,
  assignment, state, dependency/evidence, and event policies.
- Alternatives: accept revised-round later ACCEPT; infer non-slice closure from
  generic Provenance close.
- Rationale: prevents a rejected subject from becoming closable and removes
  authorization/state ambiguity across task kinds.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43; Provenance #5.

## D-023 — No generic pre-inventory adoption

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT correcting D-017 after Terra test BLOCKER
- Decision: Every matching pre-existing native component or DirectFile remains
  external and is never adopted or removed, including true-to-false reruns.
  Only the exact published user-scoped Claude v0.0.4 monolith is an approved
  migration identity; all near-matches receive zero mutation.
- Alternatives: D-017 generic selected-true adoption; infer ownership from
  matching bytes/version.
- Rationale: matching content proves identity, not that Pasture created or owns
  the user's installation.
- Surfaces: Pasture #39/#45; Proposal 28.

## D-024 — Per-entry DirectFile crash evidence

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Terra correctness/test BLOCKER
- Decision: Persist full prior and attempted manifests plus per-entry
  preflight/action/outcome/created-directory evidence before each atomic mkdir,
  temp write, rename, or unlink. Retry classifies prior, attempted, absent, or
  external under the same or newer binary.
- Alternatives: one cell-level `unknown`; rollback journal; background queue.
- Rationale: safely distinguishes partial multi-file install/update/removal
  without introducing the rejected transaction/recovery machinery.
- Surfaces: Pasture #39/#48 and target bundle fixtures.

## D-025 — Home Manager DirectFile state boundary

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Terra elegance IMPORTANT
- Decision: #39 inventory persists native cells from either caller and
  installer-owned DirectFiles only. Home Manager DirectFiles remain Nix-owned;
  status performs read-only exact inspection and reports
  `managed_declaratively` without persistent inventory/controller records.
- Alternatives: persist all nine cells through #39; add a second file ownership
  reconciler for Nix links.
- Rationale: preserves one owner per filesystem cell and avoids a false unified
  state claim.
- Surfaces: Pasture #39; Aura #8; tracker #44.

## D-026 — Selection-wide Claude legacy transition

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Terra correctness IMPORTANT
- Decision: Exact v0.0.4 monolith migration runs only through exhaustive
  `apply-selection`. While legacy/incomplete state exists, `apply-cell` fails
  before mutation and prints the full TUI/Home Manager selection remedy.
- Alternatives: let a cell command guess sibling desired state.
- Rationale: the monolith-to-split transition changes several cells and cannot
  be safely decided from one cell's input.
- Surfaces: Pasture #39/#45; Aura #8.

## D-027 — Atomic conditional workflow mutation

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 28 Terra blockers
- Decision: Provenance #5 exposes a closed declarative
  ConditionalMutationBatch with generic in-transaction task/assignment/
  relationship/event/blocker preconditions and existing mutations plus opaque
  caller-validated events. No callback, raw SQL, or Pasture payload decoder.
- Alternatives: prevalidate in #43 then make separate Apply calls; teach
  Provenance review semantics; add a second Pasture transaction store.
- Rationale: task, assignment, graph, vote, and closure facts must commit or
  roll back together without reversing the dependency boundary.
- Surfaces: Provenance #5; Pasture #14/#43.

## D-028 — Worker responsibility versus supervisor authority

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 28 Terra blockers
- Decision: Worker owner-responsibility assignment is the atomic authority for
  Task.Owner. Transfer CASes Owner and predecessor/successor together. A
  separate non-owner supervisor assignment on the governing IMPL_PLAN authorizes
  related slice closure. Close ends worker responsibility; reopen is unassigned.
- Alternatives: make supervisor equal Task.Owner; allow independent owner and
  assignment mutations.
- Rationale: preserves worker reassignment history while retaining a stable
  supervisor who alone closes reviewed slices.
- Surfaces: Provenance #5; Pasture #14/#43.

## D-029 — Review round task-graph aggregate

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 28 Terra blockers
- Decision: Review start atomically creates one round task, three axis review
  tasks, dependencies/relationships, subject event, and assignments. ACCEPT
  closes one axis task; REVISE seals the round, supersedes siblings and ends all
  assignments; finalize accepts three exact events. Re-review creates a new graph.
- Alternatives: event-only inferred round; one shared review task; Pasture-only
  review table outside Provenance transaction.
- Rationale: existing task primitives provide authoritative lifecycle and
  uniqueness without another state system.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43; Provenance #5.

## D-030 — Portable versus authoritative assignment IDs

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 28 Terra IMPORTANT
- Decision: #38 owns opaque portable AssignmentRef/TaskRef/RoleID. After the
  Provenance release, #14/#43 validates/converts them to authoritative
  AssignmentID/TaskID/AssignmentRoleID and typed slots.
- Alternatives: make compiler foundation depend on Provenance #5; use one raw
  string ID across domains.
- Rationale: keeps compiler and journal foundations parallel while retaining
  type-safe runtime continuity and authoritative persistence.
- Surfaces: Pasture #38/#14/#43/#40; Provenance #5.

## D-031 — Immutable content-addressed artifact bundles

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 28 Terra IMPORTANT/MINOR
- Decision: Independent #48 snapshots exact complete fs.FS bytes, discards the
  backing source, derives BundleID from canonical path/type/mode/content identity,
  and opens only declared leaves through fresh read-only handles. #48 has no #38
  dependency.
- Alternatives: retain mutable fs.FS; caller-supplied logical BundleID; serialize
  #48 behind compiler work.
- Rationale: validated output cannot change after construction and the neutral
  package remains a parallel foundation.
- Surfaces: Pasture #48/#24/#27/#45/#39; tracker #44.

## D-032 — Failure reporting across grouped and declarative activation

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 28 Terra IMPORTANT/MINOR
- Decision: Claude legacy reconciliation uses one private selection group with
  exact grouped row attribution and never calls public apply-cell. Home Manager
  realizes links first; declarative rows are live inspection and remain
  managed_declaratively across native failures. Direct/state temps have exact
  persisted or self-validating private identities and conservative cleanup.
- Alternatives: treat every row as sequential command attempt; let cell executor
  guess siblings; glob orphan temps.
- Rationale: result rows must describe real post-state and recovery must never
  delete an unproven external sibling.
- Surfaces: Pasture #39/#48; Aura #8.

## D-033 — Runtime value binding and mutation identity

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 29 Terra blockers
- Decision: #38 owns typed BindingKey/ValueRef/result slots and portable
  MutationRef. Runtime binds created IDs from validated CLI JSON, retains one
  MutationRef per logical retry/continuation, and #14/#43 maps it to Provenance
  OperationID. #5 batches use replay-stable local handles/result maps.
- Alternatives: embed concrete task/assignment/OperationIDs in reusable output;
  use semantic operation definition ID as invocation identity.
- Rationale: generated workflows must consume runtime-created identities while
  keeping retries byte-equivalent and distinct executions independent.
- Surfaces: Pasture #38/#14/#43/#40; Provenance #5.

## D-034 — Exact current candidate and landing object

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 29 Terra blockers
- Decision: A slice has a protected current candidate commit set by CAS. Review
  captures it; finalize/close require it unchanged; Phase 12 guarded-pushes that
  exact reviewed commit. Any later bytes/candidate require a new round.
- Alternatives: prove only that an old reviewed commit remains resolvable;
  compare a mutable worktree digest outside the database transaction.
- Rationale: immutable evidence is useful only when it is the deliverable that
  actually closes and lands.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43/#46; Provenance #5 current-revision predicate.

## D-035 — Protected task topology matrix

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 29 Terra blocker
- Decision: Generic reopen applies only to ordinary leaves. Review/slice/
  protocol tasks and contains/governs/review/supersedes topology mutate only
  through typed commands; conditional batches can require exact incoming/
  outgoing relation sets.
- Alternatives: expose generic reopen/relation mutation for every task kind and
  rely on later evidence checks.
- Rationale: authoritative topology cannot remain writable through a bypass.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43; Provenance #5.

## D-036 — Role-neutral responsibility and terminal disposition

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 29 Terra findings
- Decision: Task.Owner is role-neutral responsibility. The IMPL_PLAN owner's
  RoleSupervisor assignment governs children without a duplicate parent slot;
  Activities name AssignmentID. ACCEPT is clean-only. Each review assignment may
  submit one vote but receives exactly one disposition: accepted, revised, or
  cancelled by round revision."}

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 31 Terra BLOCKER/IMPORTANT

## D-049 — One canonical identity per review subject variant

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 31 Terra elegance IMPORTANT

## D-050 — Typed current-set Implementation UAT

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 31 Terra test IMPORTANT
- Decision: Integration UAT records a protected typed accepted or changes-

## D-051 — Proposal supersede is the proposal replacement primitive

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 31 Terra test IMPORTANT
- Decision: PROPOSAL-N+1 uses typed supersede, not document revise. One atomic

## D-052 — Non-bypassable landing evidence composition

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 31 Terra correctness BLOCKER

## D-053 — DirectFile ownership includes mode

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 31 Terra correctness IMPORTANT

## D-054 — Exact-tree success without publication rollback

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 31 Terra correctness IMPORTANT
- Decision: #46 publication owns a generated root and canonical prior-output

- Alternatives: append/overwrite only; delete an unowned root; introduce a

- Surfaces: Pasture #38/#46 and all target output/package gates.

## D-055 — Preserve and replace the empty Proposal 32 filing

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT during Proposal 32 audit verification
- Decision: Proposal 32 `aura-plugins-bg3w3` is preserved and marked superseded

## D-056 — Landing evidence is one executable composite operation

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 33 Terra BLOCKER

## D-057 — Total protected Plan and Implementation UAT algebra

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 33 Terra BLOCKER/IMPORTANT
- Decision: Both UAT phases have typed protected decision commands and immutable

## D-058 — EAGER implementation-review severity graph

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 33 Terra BLOCKER
- Decision: Plan review stays binary. Slice/integration review start creates nine

- Surfaces: Pasture #43/#14 role mapping; Phase 10 generated workflows.

## D-059 — Publication manifest is a disjoint sidecar

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 33 Terra IMPORTANT
- Decision: Derive a same-parent sidecar outside the generated payload root.

- Alternatives: put metadata inside payload equality; reserve an in-root path;

- Rationale: exact RenderedTree equality and control metadata cannot occupy the

- Surfaces: Pasture #38/#46 and target publishers.

## D-060 — Role normalization uses state, not a marker

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 33 Terra IMPORTANT
- Decision: Application/#43 extracts, conditionally transfers all eligible

## D-063 — Read-only publication replay and eligibility preflight

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 34 Terra BLOCKER/IMPORTANT findings
- Decision: Provenance #5 exposes a side-effect-free exact committed-operation

- Alternatives: always rerun already-at-target verification before Apply and
  provide no replay-only result; perform eligibility validation only after Git;
  introduce a Git/SQLite transaction or global publication lock.
- Rationale: lost-response replay must not require Git, stale-at-entry calls must
  not mutate a remote, and duplicate MutationRefs must not duplicate evidence.
  A race after the read-only preflight remains an explicitly nontransactional

- UAT question: confirm that post-preflight rework races should require explicit

## D-064 — Separate UAT interactions, feedback, and held questions

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 34 Terra correctness BLOCKER
- Decision: Normal question/options/definition/command/verbatim-answer records

  or DEFER. Plan-UAT questions held for Implementation UAT have their own type

- Surfaces: Pasture #43 UAT API/CLI/events; ratify/land/follow-up gates.

## D-065 — Findings resolve only through evidence-bound subject replacement

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 34 Terra BLOCKER findings
- Decision: There is no public in-place `finding-resolve` operation. Fixes use

- Alternatives: resolve findings while C1 stays current; forbid rework until a

- Rationale: review must prove the bytes that contain the fix and no obsolete

  specific replacement rather than remain open after C2 becomes current.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43 review/slice/integration algebra and Phase 10 workflows.

## D-066 — Plan finalize is the sole terminal owner

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 34 Terra elegance IMPORTANT
- Decision: All three Plan-review axes submit one binary vote and end their own
  assignments. Submit never closes the round or cancels siblings. `review
  finalize` alone derives ACCEPT when all accept or REVISE otherwise and owns the
  terminal event/dependency transition. Proposal supersede alone invalidates an
  unfinished round.
- Alternatives: first REVISE submit closes the round and cancels siblings;
  permit both submit and finalize to close REVISE.
- Rationale: one terminal owner removes conflicting state transitions and keeps

- UAT question: confirm complete three-axis feedback is preferred even when an
  earlier Plan-review axis already voted REVISE.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43 Plan review API/CLI/events and proposal supersession.

## D-067 — #43 owns publication identity and every success commits a result

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 35 Terra correctness/test/elegance
- Decision: #43 alone canonicalizes a versioned PublicationIntent and its
  CanonicalCommandDigest. #14 maps MutationRef, historical actor, and digest
  byte-preserving into #5 lookup/Apply; #40 never maps identity or calls #5.
  Process-local Git proof gates append but is not part of canonical intent bytes.
  Existing evidence and concurrent append convergence commit a result-only
  OperationID binding to the one canonical EventID, so every successful status
  replays identically without creating duplicate evidence.
- Alternatives: let #40 construct/marshal Provenance identity; return read-only
  already-recorded success without an operation row; include ephemeral Git proof
  in the replay command digest.
- Rationale: lookup and Apply need one provably identical command identity, and
  logical continuation requires lost responses to replay after authority/repo
  state changes.
- UAT question: confirm that a result-only operation row referencing existing
  evidence is acceptable audit state and not the pending/transaction machinery
  previously rejected.
- Surfaces: Provenance #5; Pasture #14/#43/#40; publication/landing.

## D-068 — Implementation UAT requires total typed carry-forward coverage

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 35 Terra BLOCKER/IMPORTANT findings
- Decision: Plan decisions, held questions, deferred feedback, ledger revisions,
  and ledger entries use stable typed IDs. The ledger is immutable-revisioned;
  implementation judgments extend rather than mutate the Plan-bound snapshot.
  Implementation UAT binds the exact Plan decision and current successor ledger,
  then requires a bijection over every held question, Plan-DEFER feedback, and
  RequiresUAT ledger entry. A coverage digest is part of accepted evidence and
  the land predicate. FIX-NOW or ledger REPLACE forces changes-requested; user-
  confirmed DEFER alone feeds follow-up.
- Alternatives: present the ledger text informally; reference only its mutable
  TaskID; allow user acceptance without mechanically complete coverage.
- Rationale: the user's overnight deferral is safe only if no held question or
  agent judgment can disappear before the morning Implementation-UAT gate.
- UAT question: review and disposition every stable carry-forward item; acceptance
  is intentionally unavailable until coverage is complete.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43 UAT/ledger API, ratify, land, follow-up generation.

## D-069 — Distinguish finding fixes from independent subject drift

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 35 Terra elegance IMPORTANT
- Decision: `address_findings` rework waits for all three implementation-review
  inventories and binds every finding to a distinct replacement plus Activity/
  Git/test evidence. `independent_content_replacement` may invalidate a partial
  round only while every submitted inventory is finding-free; it explicitly
  records incomplete invalidation and never claims findings were addressed.
- Alternatives: rework after the first finding and cancel unseen inventories;
  forbid all candidate replacement until three submissions; use one ambiguous
  rework reason.
- Rationale: fixes need the complete three-axis finding set, while genuine
  unrelated drift should not force reviewers to finish inspecting obsolete bytes.
- UAT question: confirm partial independent replacement is acceptable only before
  any reviewer reports a finding.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43 slice/integration review and Phase-10 workflows.

## D-070 — Tracker #44 is normative and must match the ratified state machine

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 35 Terra correctness BLOCKER
- Decision: Tracker #44 is synchronized in every proposal revision before review
  because it is the Phase-8 implementation entrypoint. It now uses all-three Plan
  submissions/finalize, `REVISE_REPLACED`, two typed rework reasons, total UAT
  carry-forward, and #43-owned publication identity/result binding.
- Alternatives: treat #44 as a nonnormative summary and let implementation use

- Rationale: contradictory normative trackers recreate the exact ambiguity the

- Surfaces: Pasture #44 and all dependent implementation slices.

## D-071 — Two-stage canonicalization and exact replay authority

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 36 Terra correctness/test findings
- Decision: After resolving typed inputs, the runtime first calls #43's pure
  command canonicalizer. Only then does it mint MutationRef and durably record a
  complete continuation. Stateful preparation recomputes and validates the
  digest before lookup. #14 maps the exact initiating AssignmentRef or bootstrap
  identity to #5 OperationAuthorityID; replay compares OperationID, ActorID,
  exact authority, and command digest.
- Alternatives: let preparation produce a digest after continuation recording;
  accept a placeholder/caller digest; compare only AgentID.
- Rationale: removes the construction cycle and prevents same-Agent assignments,

## D-072 — Narrow conditional existing-ID result binding

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 36 Terra BLOCKERs
- Decision: Provenance #5 ConditionalMutationBatch gains one closed zero-domain/

  EventID and derives outcome from its protected payload.
- Alternatives: return read-only convergence without durable replay; add a

- Rationale: every successful logical mutation needs replayable results without

## D-073 — Independent replacement is total across clean nonterminal states

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 36 Terra rework BLOCKERs
- Decision: `independent_content_replacement` is legal before close/land whenever

  branches, preserves already-terminal clean axes/assignments and immutable
  historical evidence, invalidates current eligibility, installs C2, and forces

- Alternatives: add a separate post-finalize mode; forbid all post-finalize

- Rationale: one independent-drift mode is total without double-terminalization

- Surfaces: Pasture #43 slice/integration review, UAT, publication, land.

## D-074 — Protected ledger producer and stale-UAT invalidation

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 36 Terra ledger BLOCKER/IMPORTANT

- Rationale: the carry-forward consumer needs one authoritative producer and no

- UAT question: confirm all post-Plan agent judgments should mechanically reopen

- Surfaces: Pasture #43 protocol/ledger/UAT/land and tracker #44.

## D-075 — User-confirmed ledger source requires protected human evidence

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 37 Terra correctness/test/elegance
  BLOCKERs
- Decision: The ordinary ledger-owner append always derives
  SourceAgentJudgment from its exact mutation authority. SourceUserConfirmed is

  complete stimulus, verbatim answer, entry, and digests. Unbacked, stale,

- Surfaces: Pasture #43 decision ledger/UAT; tracker #44.

## D-076 — Decision ledger reuses document revisions and every append invalidates UAT

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 37 Terra correctness/elegance
  BLOCKER/IMPORTANT findings
- Decision: DECISION_LEDGER uses the existing DocumentRevisionID plus reserved
  current-revision topology, with an append-only ledger codec. Every successor

- Surfaces: Pasture #43 protected documents, UAT, land; tracker #44.

## D-077 — Mutation continuation freezes the complete resolved request and scope

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 37 Terra correctness BLOCKER
- Decision: Before the first stateful attempt, the durable continuation stores
  MutationRef, exact initiating authority, semantic operation/request schema,

- Surfaces: Pasture #38/#40/#43, #14 adapter, generated runtime bindings.

## D-078 — Public handle sum receives exhaustive fixtures and drift rules name the live subject

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 37 Terra test/elegance findings
- Decision: Keep all four ConditionalExistingIDResult handle branches—Task,

- Surfaces: Provenance #5; Pasture #14/#43 rework; tracker #44.

- Decision: Compilation/lowering/native validation happens wholly in memory and
  returns one complete #38 RenderedTree or no tree/publisher call. #46 owns a
  later per-file publication effect whose failures may be partial and are
  reported exactly; no atomic directory replacement is claimed.
- Alternatives: stage/swap whole output roots with crash recovery; allow late
  validation after writes.
- Rationale: preserves the no-partial compiler guarantee without adding another
  transaction/recovery protocol.
- Surfaces: Pasture #38/#46/#40 and target artifact generation.

## D-046 — Executor-tagged installer remedies and valid-unknown probe rows

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 30 Terra correctness/test IMPORTANT
- Decision: Diagnostics select ApplyCell, ApplySelection/RerunInstaller,
  RerunHomeManager, ManualNativeTrust, or ManualRepair for irreducible state
  ambiguity. Optional all-false valid external or
  ambiguous Claude state is a successful preservation no-op with no inventory;
  required ambiguous state fails before mutation, while exact external state may
  satisfy desired state without adoption.
- Alternatives: print apply-cell universally; leave valid unknown rows implicit;
  fail optional preservation probes.
- Rationale: every repair must work for its executor, and valid preservation
  outcomes need exact observable rows rather than inferred behavior.
- Surfaces: Pasture #39; Aura #8 error/result fixtures.

## D-047 — Atomic integration-set replacement

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 31 Terra BLOCKER
- Decision: One authoritative integration task permits initial candidate-set
  creation only from none. Every subsequent deliverable change uses an atomic
  integration rework that terminalizes live review state/dependencies,
  invalidates Implementation UAT, creates and swaps the immutable set, and
  permits a fresh round.
- Alternatives: overwrite the set relation; leave the old round to fail later;
  create a second integration task.
- Rationale: replacement at 0/A/AB/ABC votes cannot strand a current round or
  blocker on obsolete bytes.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43; integration review/UAT/landing.

## D-048 — Application-owned total role normalization

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 31 Terra BLOCKER/IMPORTANT
- Decision: The application/#43 startup coordinator calls #14 read-only
  extraction. A closed table maps every reserved Pasture kind/FOLLOWUP topology;
  ordinary non-Pasture tasks retain generic roles and do not block activation.
  #43 owns the marker and post-marker inspection.
- Alternatives: #14 invokes #43; normalize every Provenance task; leave unknown
  task kinds implicit.
- Rationale: this removes the dependency cycle and makes the migration domain
  total without forcing Pasture policy onto generic tasks.
- Surfaces: Provenance #5; Pasture #14/#43 startup and migration fixtures.

## D-049 — One canonical identity per review subject variant

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 31 Terra elegance IMPORTANT
- Decision: DocumentRevisionID, TaskCandidateID, or IntegrationCandidateSetID is
  the sole canonical identity of its variant. ReviewSubjectRef is derived from
  that ID and kind, never supplied independently. Document identity avoids the
  name TaskRevisionID.
- Alternatives: store generic SubjectID beside the variant ID; use only one
  untyped generic subject ID.
- Rationale: two IDs wrapping the same snapshot permit disagreement and confuse
  immutable subject identity with mutable-task CAS revisions.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43/#38 bindings; review/close schemas.

## D-050 — Typed current-set Implementation UAT

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 31 Terra test IMPORTANT
- Decision: Integration UAT records a protected typed accepted or changes-
  requested result for the exact current set, UAT task, and registered human.
  Every verbatim feedback item requires explicit user-confirmed FIX-NOW or DEFER;
  confirmed DEFER feeds the follow-up epic, while FIX-NOW or changes-requested
  cannot authorize land until rework/review/UAT completes.
- Alternatives: treat comments as acceptance; infer dispositions; accept any UAT
  event associated with the epoch.
- Rationale: landing needs one closed observable acceptance oracle and the
  protocol requires explicit disposition of every UAT item.
- Surfaces: Pasture #43; IntegrationCandidateSet; Implementation UAT/follow-up.

## D-051 — Proposal supersede is the proposal replacement primitive

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 31 Terra test IMPORTANT
- Decision: PROPOSAL-N+1 uses typed supersede, not document revise. One atomic
  transition installs the sole canonical successor, terminalizes any live old
  review branch, invalidates old Plan UAT, and preserves finalized history as
  ineligible. Review/UAT/ratify/supersede races have one winner.
- Alternatives: edit/revise the proposal task; update canonical pointers outside
  the review invalidation batch.
- Rationale: the proposal protocol is immutable and tests must exercise the

- Surfaces: Pasture #43; proposal/review/Plan-UAT/ratify.

## D-052 — Non-bypassable landing evidence composition

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 31 Terra correctness BLOCKER

  evidence append. Zero/fabricated/wrong-set values write nothing.
- Alternatives: trust a publicly recordable event kind; let #43 import and call

- Source: AGENT-JUDGMENT resolving Proposal 31 Terra correctness IMPORTANT

- Alternatives: authorize from type/digest only; silently restore declared mode.
